oracle.statement: for malformed never-created path probes (NUL %00, %2F-in-name, %zz, lone-surrogate %ED%A0%80, dot-segments): 404 or 400/422 = clean; HTTP 2xx = Type1_IllegalSuccess (config for a nonexistent/malformed name); 5xx = Type3_RuntimeFailure; other channels = Type4_StateLogicViolation; dot-segments additionally tolerate 200 of a non-describe shape (routing normalization) but fail on 5xx or a describe-envelope 200
